text:
Diego: Heads-up — scheduling a canary for payments-service (payments-v2) tomorrow 10:00 PT. Plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 0m/30m/90m. Cohorts: US-east users then expand to mobile+web. Need smoke/rollback owners. Objections?

Alice: sgtm. I can own smoke for US-east. What do we want to validate specifically? latency, 5xx, downstream success rate?

Ben: I can be rollback owner and standby during the window. Add me to the rota. How are we detecting regressions — static thresholds or anomaly?

Chen: Recommend simple thresholds to keep it fast: p95 latency +50% vs baseline sustained >5m OR error rate >0.5% sustained 3m -> trigger alert. Also watch cache hitrate drop and threadpool saturation.

Diego: Sounds good. Also plan automatic model fallback: rwd-model-v2-quant -> rwd-model-v1-quant on severe errors. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary and annotate owners?

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary start at 1715003600 (tomorrow 10:00 PT). Rollout steps: 1% @0m, 5% @30m, 20% @90m. Auto-fallback to v1 if error rate >0.5% for 5m unless manually overridden. Rollback owner: Ben. Smoke owner: Alice.

Elaine: I'll run the smoke checklist and post results in #eng-sre. Quick checks I'll do at 10:05 PT: health endpoints, payment flow trace, key rotation sanity.

Alice: Smoke checklist (copy/paste):
```
- curl -f https://payments.internal/health -> 200
- run load-smoke.sh -n 50 (simulate payment tokens)
- sample 10 successful payment responses and 10 failed ones
- verify KV cache hitrate > 60% and redis latency < 5ms
- check tracing spans for <2x span duration vs baseline
```

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll be at my laptop. Rollback command is:
```
./infra/deploy rollback --service payments --target-version v1 --reason "canary-fallthrough"
```

Chen: Cohort gating details: start with 1% bucketed by cookie on mobile iOS only. If green, expand 5% by adding Android + a 2% web subset. We'll use the router weight header `X-Canary: payments-v2` to validate traffic.

Diego: I'll update the runbook with cohort mappings and owners. Anyone blocked by infra capacity?

Alice: No capacity issues. Dedicated GPUs warmed and warmup completed at 09:45 PT.

Ben: I'll add a quick health probe to the traffic router to ensure weights are applied and to prevent leak to v2 if misconfigured: check header `X-Canary` present and weight matches expected.

Diego: Great. If all green at 20% we'll plan the next ramp later today. Post smoke logs and any anomalies to this thread. Thanks all :partyparrot:
